items.description: Portriat of Hyder Ali wearing an elaborate large round turban with plumes and a red tunic. Hyder Ali Khan (c. 1720 – 7 December 1782) became the de facto ruler of Mysore as Sarvadhikari (Chief Minister) by 1761. He fought against the military advances of the British East India Company during the First and Second Anglo–Mysore Wars, and he was the innovator of military use of the iron-cased Mysorean
